defaultContent.title: Why parents choose Dolphin Kids.
defaultContent.lead: Six commitments that shape every day on our Greater Noida campus.
defaultContent.image_alt: Children at Dolphin Kids during a classroom activity

items.title: Qualified and experienced teachers
items.text: Early childhood educators who know each child by name, pace and personality, with ongoing professional development.

items.title: Language and speech development
items.text: Phonics, storytelling, Show and Tell and public speaking, so children find their words and use them with confidence.

items.title: Positive behavioural management and PSED
items.text: Empathy, sharing and self-regulation, taught gently through daily routines and guided play.

items.title: Caring and supportive staff
items.text: Warm caregivers, close parent communication and emotional support through every settling-in day.

items.title: Extensive campus and learning infrastructure
items.text: Labs, studios, indoor and outdoor play zones, and dedicated activity centres under one roof.

items.title: Safety and individual attention
items.text: Management-listed CCTV, infirmary and age-appropriate spaces, with attention that stays on your child. See them on a visit.

safety.title: See it for yourself,
safety.lead: These facilities are listed by school management. The best reassurance is your own visit, so here is what to look at and what to ask.
safety.image_alt: A space on the Dolphin Kids campus

facilities.title: CCTV on campus
facilities.text: Ask where cameras cover and how footage is handled.

facilities.title: Infirmary
facilities.text: Ask who attends to a child who feels unwell, and how you are told.

facilities.title: In-house kitchen
facilities.text: Ask to see the kitchen and a sample weekly menu.

facilities.title: Rest and age-appropriate spaces
facilities.text: Ask how nap, play and learning areas are set up for each age.

ask: Who will greet and settle my child each morning?
How are children handed over at pick-up?
How will I hear about my child's day?
What happens if my child is unwell during the day?
Which staff are with my child in Day Care hours?
